headline: CINF Q2 Deep Dive: Slower Premium Growth and Margin Expansion Amid Industry Headwinds
summary: Property casualty insurer Cincinnati Financial (NASDAQ:CINF) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 6.9% year on year to $2.97 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.43 per share was 21.3% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Cincinnati Financial: The Equity Portfolio Saved Q2, But Commercial Lines Need Attention
summary: Cincinnati Financial reported strong Q2 net income driven by $1.3B in pre-tax investment gains, primarily from its sizable equity portfolio. Learn more about CINF stock here.
